entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tomáš Nosek is a Czech professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League (NHL). Nosek began his professional career in the Czech Extraliga with HC Pardubice before signing with the Detroit Red Wings as an undrafted free agent in 2014. After developing in the American Hockey League (AHL) with the Grand Rapids Griffins, he played a key role in their 2017 Calder Cup championship run. Later he won the Stanley Cup with Florida Panthers.
